build_load_frame_processor_module: build a function that loads a frame processor module by name and validates it implements the required interface
create_get_frame_processors_modules: create a function that loads and returns a list of frame processor modules from a list of processor names
run_multi_process_frame: run frames in parallel using a thread pool executor with batched memory management
run_process_video_in_memory: run in-memory video processing using FFmpeg pipes to eliminate disk I/O bottleneck
run_process_video: run video processing with a tqdm progress bar over extracted frame paths using multi-process-frame
